### Reference: actions

#### `action`

function · `import { action } from '@harness/sdk'`

Declare an action. Without `returns` it returns nothing.

```ts
function action<I, R = undefined, St extends object = {}>(def: { description: string; input: GinType<I>; returns?: GinType<R>; state?: GinType<St>; expires?: Duration; }): ActionDef<I, R, St>;
```

Refers to: [`Duration`](#core-duration).

#### `ActionDef`

interface · `import { ActionDef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A typed message a system accepts from its renderers ("approve", "load more"). The hub stores each one before
delivering it, so nothing is lost while the system is offline.

```ts
interface ActionDef<I, R, St extends object> {
  readonly description: string;
  readonly input: GinType<I>;
  readonly returns: GinType<R>;
  readonly state: GinType<St> | undefined;
  /** Drop it if it can't be delivered within this long. Default: never. */
  readonly expires: Duration | undefined;
}
```

Refers to: [`Duration`](#core-duration).

#### `ActionImpl`

type · `import { ActionImpl } from '@harness/sdk'`

An action's implementation.

```ts
type ActionImpl<I, R, St extends object, Cfg = unknown> = (input: I, ctx: ActionCtx<St, Cfg>) => Promise<R>;
```

#### `ActionCtx`

interface · `import { ActionCtx } from '@harness/sdk'`

What an action's implementation gets.

```ts
interface ActionCtx<St extends object, Cfg = unknown> extends SystemCtx<Cfg>, AskerCtx, Omit<Services, 'log' | 'llm' | 'resources' | 'types'> {
  readonly delivery: DeliveryId;
  /** The run whose renderer sent it, if any. */
  readonly run: RunId | undefined;
  readonly actor: ActorId;
  readonly state: SessionState<St>;
}
```

Refers to: [`ActorId`](#core-actorid), [`DeliveryId`](#core-deliveryid), [`RunId`](#core-runid).

#### `ActionRef`

interface · `import { ActionRef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A typed handle to an action a system's renderers may send.

```ts
interface ActionRef<N extends QualifiedName, I, R> {
  readonly ref: 'action';
  readonly name: N;
  readonly input: GinType<I>;
  readonly returns: GinType<R>;
}
```

Refers to: [`QualifiedName`](#core-qualifiedname).
